lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Doerkson’s a fan of Carney’s budget, but it may not work as a template for B.C, The Canadian Press reports.
US president confirms Susie Wiles, current chief of staff and first woman to serve in the role, will step down, The Guardian reports.
Meghan’s father Thomas Markle appears in court over child sex abuse material, BBC News reports.
Tesla’s Cybertruck, the hulking, stainless-steel pickup that inspired devotion and derision with its science-fiction looks, will cease production next year, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
